The $(l:Skeleton$) is a common monster that spawns in dark places in the $(l:Overworld$), including the surface at night. It attacks players on sight by keeping its distance and firing with a $(l:Bow$). It burns when exposed to sunlight.

A $(l:Skeleton$) may spawn wearing armor, making it tougher and protecting it from sunlight if it wears a helmet.
Skeletons drop $(l:Bones$) on death. They can be used to tame $(l:Wolves$) or to make $(l:Bone Meal$) to fertilize plants.
